lines.say: Stop asking AI for leave messages before showing it three of yours.
Bus home, you ask for a sick leave message.
lines.show: Bus home: 'sick leave message to my manager'

lines.say: You get: I hope this message finds you well.
lines.show: 'I hope this message finds you well.'

lines.say: It's never seen you write. A tailor without measurements.
lines.show: It's never seen how you write.

lines.say: Paste three messages you sent. Those are your measurements.
Ask it to note your sentence length, words and sign-off.
lines.show: Note my length, words, sign-off. Then write.

lines.say: Now: fever since morning, off today, back tomorrow. That's you.
The catch: it learns your mistakes as well. Read first. Never paste others' chats.
lines.show: Copies typos too. Never paste others' chats.

lines.say: Send this to the colleague whose messages all sound like a bank. Comment STYLE.
lines.show: Send this. Comment STYLE for the prompt.
